captions.detailed: A wireless home all-in-one desktop printer, finished in a matte light gray plastic with dark gray or black functional components. It features a low-profile main body with a flatbed scanner lid, a rear paper tray guide, and a front output tray nested beneath a compact control strip. The control strip hosts a single rotating selector dial and four small, square, pushable button controls. The printer is designed with realistic hollowed cavities for the paper path and scanner bed, allowing the scanner lid to pivot upward, the rear paper guide to fold back, and the front output tray to swing down.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a home all-in-one printer with realistic, hollowed-out internal cavities. The printer must feature a main body, an adjustable rear paper guide, a rotating flatbed scanner lid, a front-folding output tray, and a control strip containing a continuous selector dial and four separate prismatic push buttons. Apply a light gray plastic material to the main body and panels, and a contrasting dark gray to the controls and paper path components.
captions.factory: The printer is constructed by first creating a main body using a hollowed box primitive with a front slot cutout for the output tray. A flatbed scanner lid and a rear paper guide are modeled as thin box structures, positioned and constrained via revolute joints to pivot along their respective rear axes. The front output tray is similarly mounted on a front hinge. The control panel is detailed with a cylindrical selector dial on a continuous joint and four small box primitives configured as prismatic push buttons. The final assembly is organized with light gray and dark gray materials applied to distinguish the housing from the functional controls.
